response_excerpt.summary:
Traffic channel performance summary across all 4 channels (organic, referral, social, ads):

- **Page Views**: All channels have ~700K PVs, with referral leading at 701,830 and organic at 700,230.
- **Unique Visitors**: referral (421,141) and ads (420,576) lead slightly over social (413,926) and organic (413,192).
- **Paid Orders**: referral and ads each generated 1,000 paid orders; social and organic each had 955.
- **Paid Revenue**: ads generated the highest revenue (~$969,919), followed by social (~$817,104), referral (~$783,216), and organic (~$632,520).
- **Conversion Rate**: All channels show a consistent ~0.02% conversion rate (paid unique users / total UV), indicating similar funnel efficiency across channels.
